reviewed_invariants.assessment: Operation count, bytes and cleanup record are reserved under one mutex with close; separately bounded FIFO waiter metadata, no bypass of head, canceled receiver/drop returns credit once; zero/impossible cases reject before payload.

Arc clones retain one stage/reservation. Close rejects new start while an issued reservation remains charged. The actual adapter that already accepted its A07 table publishes one canceled terminal and returns accepted start, avoiding callback-then-rejection.

One native future/blocking body and one supervisor per admitted operation. Supervisor retains reservation through actual JoinHandle completion; concrete owner retains it through A07 quiet/drain. Payload field destruction precedes its own reservation release. Task completion alone does not return bytes.

Runtime owner thread waits closing+zero admitted+zero tasks, then actual Runtime drop joins Tokio workers including blocking work. External observer joins runtime-owner thread; close-retire joins the finished observer before A07 acknowledgement. No shutdown_timeout/background or dropped handle proves join.

Actual poll/body JoinError is mapped and poisons admission; unknown panic payloads quarantined without Drop. Completion uses A05 cleanup boundary with explicit UnwindSafe bounds. Known-safe cleanup remains reachable and logical payload counters do not claim total RSS.

One preallocated A07 close operation; caller cancellation only wraps its shared completion. Successful join result is checked after independent native/managed retirement. No native control call, callback query or await occurs while an A08 managed admission lock is held. Owned callback scope can request stop and is rejected from self-wait.

Rust component opt-in per Engine; conformance exports behind feature; Core contains only internal close observation and starts no native runtime. No new public scheduler/package. Existing A17 synchronous no-runtime evidence reused.
